# TC2000 — How to import trades from TC2000 into TradeZella using the file upload method?

Source: https://help.tradezella.com/en/articles/9627943-tc2000-how-to-import-trades-from-tc2000-into-tradezella-using-the-file-upload-method

To import your trades from TC2000 into TradeZella, follow these steps:



## Exporting trade data from TC2000 into a file

- Launch the TC2000 desktop application.

Launch the TC2000 desktop application.

- Click on the Account selection dropdown.

Click on the Account selection dropdown.

- Choose the brokerage or paper account for which you want to export trade history.

Choose the brokerage or paper account for which you want to export trade history.

- Click on the Trading menu button.

Click on the Trading menu button.

- Select "Export Trade History" from the dropdown menu.

Select "Export Trade History" from the dropdown menu.

- In the Export Trade History editor, click the Export dropdown button.

In the Export Trade History editor, click the Export dropdown button.

- Choose the date range desired. Use "Trades In Date Range" to specify a specific time span.

Choose the date range desired. Use "Trades In Date Range" to specify a specific time span.

- Select "Comma delimited" as the export file type.

Select "Comma delimited" as the export file type.

- Click "Export".

Click "Export".

- Set the destination folder where you want to save the exported file.

Set the destination folder where you want to save the exported file.

- Optionally, rename the file if desired (default name uses the date range selected).

Optionally, rename the file if desired (default name uses the date range selected).

- Click "Save" to save the document to the designated folder.

Click "Save" to save the document to the designated folder.



## Uploading the exported file into TradeZella

- Visit the TradeZella Add Trade page here or by clicking the “Add Trade” button on the sidebar.

Visit the TradeZella Add Trade page here or by clicking the “Add Trade” button on the sidebar.

- On the Add Trade page, click “Add New Account” if you’re creating a new account for these trades.

On the Add Trade page, click “Add New Account” if you’re creating a new account for these trades.

If you’re uploading trades to an existing account, simply click on the “Add Trades” button in the account field:

- On the Add New Account page, select TC2000 as the broker and click Continue.

On the Add New Account page, select TC2000 as the broker and click Continue.

- Next, select the File Upload method and click Continue again.

Next, select the File Upload method and click Continue again.

- On the final step, select the timezone of the file and upload the file. The system will handle the rest.

On the final step, select the timezone of the file and upload the file. The system will handle the rest.



## Common Errors

- Ensure your exported CSV file from TC2000 includes all necessary trade details.

Ensure your exported CSV file from TC2000 includes all necessary trade details.

- If your file fails to upload, verify that it matches the sample TC200 export provided. Ensure all required columns are correctly formatted and populated.

If your file fails to upload, verify that it matches the sample TC200 export provided. Ensure all required columns are correctly formatted and populated.
